data.one_liner: Code generator for Flutter ThemeExtension classes to minimize boilerplate code.
data.what_it_does: Generates copyWith, lerp, merge, ==, hashCode methods, and BuildContext extensions for Flutter ThemeExtension and custom theme classes via annotations.
use_when: You are implementing Flutter 3 ThemeExtension classes and want to eliminate boilerplate.
You want automatic BuildContext extensions for convenient access to your custom themes.
avoid_when: You prefer writing all theme extension methods and boilerplate manually.
You cannot use build_runner or code generation in your workflow.
strengths: Eliminates repetitive boilerplate for copyWith, lerp, merge, equality, and hash code.
Provides convenient BuildContext extensions for theme access.
Supports complex types like EdgeInsets, TextStyles, Durations, and custom types.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation.
copyWith cannot set a nullable field to null.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding build_runner and theme_extensions_builder as dev dependencies and running build_runner to generate files.
